ios.desc:
Experience Hacker News in a beautifully designed app. 
Crafted for tech enthusiasts, developers, and startup founders who want the best reading experience for their daily HN browsing.


Key Features:

Premium Reading Experience: Clean interface with both light and dark modes for comfortable reading any time
Smart Reader Mode: Articles are automatically formatted for optimal readability in our in-app browser
Intelligent Bookmarking: Save interesting stories locally with one tap for later reading.
Multiple Categories: Easily browse different HN sections including Top, New, Best, Ask HN, and Show HN
Seamless Browser Integration: Read articles directly in the app with our powerful in-app browser
Offline Support: Access your saved articles anytime, anywhere

Native iOS Design: Intuitive interface following iOS design guidelines for a familiar experience

Perfect for:

Software developers staying updated with tech trends
Startup founders tracking industry news
Tech professionals following important discussions
Anyone who loves intelligent tech discourse
